input.rationale: Section 4.1 is framed as a non-renewal mechanic and gives the Company no express mid-term convenience exit, while HDI's notice may fix any Termination Date and so lets HDI walk away mid-term; Section 4.2(a) then charges the Company an uncapped Termination Payment equal to half of (twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000). We therefore (i) insert a standalone Section 4.1A giving the Company an express convenience termination on ninety (90) days' prior written notice, within the 60-90 day fallback band, (ii) confine HDI's no-cause termination to the end of the then-current term while retaining the mutual 90-day notice, and (iii) cap the Termination Payment at the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three months preceding the Termination Date, an ascertainable three-months-of-fees ceiling that leaves the 4.2(b) zero floor and 4.2(c) instalment schedule intact. This lands the clause at the fallback; the preferred 30-day notice and pro-rata refund are not pursued.

ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
